def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['n']
    k = inputs['k']
    
    # Josephus problem: find survivor position (1-indexed)
    # We use 0-indexed internally, then convert back
    
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))  # 1-indexed positions
    current = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Remove every k-th person
        current = (current + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(current)
        # After removal, current points to the next person
        if len(people) > 0:
            current = current % len(people)
    
    return float(people[0])
